blinding_note: The scorer's inputs exclude every corpus defect annotation: only the run's own artifacts (diff, PR title/body, findings, review summary, review_result, required checks, coverage) reach the scorer prompt, so the scorer grades the review blind to the ground-truth defect anchor. Defect metadata is used only offline, by the report, for calibration math.

rubric.source: src/confidence/prompt.ts production prompt + src/confidence/result.ts deterministic ceilings
rubric.provenance: pinned at plan creation; bridge bundles from the checked-out source tree

selection_rationale: The vulnerable mix spans security (pr-reviewer-action-554-597 maintainer gate, miso-gallery-56-207 unauthenticated route), correctness/availability (pr-reviewer-action-131-274, courier-46-61, dispatch-121-252, alert-triage-53-62), config/CI (pr-reviewer-action-16-61), and supply-chain/minor (pr-reviewer-action-457-547). The clean corpus entries carry no titles, so their domain mix is recorded as unknown — a documented limitation of this pilot, not a claim about those PRs.

ceilings.temperature: omitted — matches the production scorer request, which sends no temperature field
ceilings.retries: none — a failed call is recorded unscored, never retried

conditions.purpose: control: the scorer lane is off; rows carry the canonical disabled result and consume no calls
offline validation of the plumbing: canned raw answers exercised through the production parse/ceiling path

conditions.independence: same endpoint+model as the primary lane — anchoring/variance control, NOT independent evidence
distinct model family per plan; the operator must configure a different family than the primary — the driver cannot verify family identity, recorded as an unknown
